name: Forward-Mode Derivatives for Voxelization
definition: Computes the tangent (derivative) of the occupancy grid with respect to mesh vertex positions, given vertex tangents. It propagates derivatives through the voxelization process (clipping and integration) using forward-mode automatic differentiation.
summary: Forward-mode derivatives for voxelization compute occupancy grid tangents by propagating vertex derivatives through the voxelization process, differing from backward-mode by computing gradients directly during the forward pass.
